quests.coreMeaning: Arriving after the expected time.
quests.whyDifferent: 'Late' describes people or trains off schedule. 'Delayed' means held back by a specific cause or announcement.

makeovers.beforeSentence: Flight 402 is ___ by thirty minutes due to fog.
makeovers.earVerdict: Natural — transport schedules held up by causes use 'delayed'.
makeovers.spokenSentence: Flight 402 is delayed by thirty minutes due to fog.

makeovers.beforeSentence: Excuse me for being ___ to the morning meeting.
makeovers.earVerdict: Doesn't fit — people arriving behind schedule say 'late', not 'delayed'.
makeovers.spokenSentence: Excuse me for being late to the morning meeting.

cousinWords.miniContext: Heavy rain left morning commuter trains slightly overdue.
Flight 402 is postponed by thirty minutes due to fog.
Tardy marks the strongest tone in personal -> schedule.

quests.coreMeaning: Happening on time or ahead of expectation.
quests.whyDifferent: 'Early' means before the clock time. 'Prompt' praises fast, reliable response right on time.

makeovers.beforeSentence: Customers appreciated the ___ delivery within two hours.
makeovers.earVerdict: Natural — 'prompt' praises fast, punctual service.
makeovers.spokenSentence: Customers appreciated the prompt delivery within two hours.

makeovers.beforeSentence: He sets an ___ alarm for five in the morning.
makeovers.earVerdict: Doesn't fit — clock hours use 'early', never 'prompt'.
makeovers.spokenSentence: He sets an early alarm for five in the morning.

cousinWords.miniContext: Sending a quick reply helps guests book with confidence.
Customers appreciated the timely delivery within two hours.
Punctual marks the strongest tone in clock vs service.

quests.coreMeaning: To bring an activity or task to completion.
quests.whyDifferent: 'End' applies to stories, meetings, or streets. 'Finish' means completing work you were actively doing.

makeovers.beforeSentence: Try to ___ your essay before dinner starts.
makeovers.earVerdict: Natural — completing personal tasks takes 'finish'.
makeovers.spokenSentence: Try to finish your essay before dinner starts.

makeovers.beforeSentence: The coastal highway will ___ at the lighthouse.
makeovers.earVerdict: Doesn't fit — physical paths 'end', they do not 'finish'.
makeovers.spokenSentence: The coastal highway will end at the lighthouse.

cousinWords.miniContext: Workers hope to stop painting the fence before dark.
Try to complete your essay before dinner starts.
Conclude marks the strongest tone in halt -> mastery.

quests.coreMeaning: Free from mistakes or accurate.
quests.whyDifferent: 'Right' works for sides (`right hand`), justice, and answers. 'Correct' highlights accuracy against rules or facts.

makeovers.beforeSentence: Only two students wrote the ___ date on the form.
makeovers.earVerdict: Natural — factual or test accuracy fits 'correct'.
makeovers.spokenSentence: Only two students wrote the correct date on the form.

makeovers.beforeSentence: Turn ___ at the bakery to reach the post office.
makeovers.earVerdict: Doesn't fit — compass/body direction must use 'right'.
makeovers.spokenSentence: Turn right at the bakery to reach the post office.

cousinWords.miniContext: Double-check every number so the invoice is exact.
Only two students wrote the accurate date on the form.
True marks the strongest tone in everyday -> exact.

quests.coreMeaning: Not matching facts or truth.
quests.whyDifferent: 'Wrong' covers bad choices, errors, and wrong turns. 'False' describes invented claims or fake items.

makeovers.beforeSentence: That online rumor proved completely ___ yesterday.
makeovers.earVerdict: Natural — untrue claims and statements are 'false'.
makeovers.spokenSentence: That online rumor proved completely false yesterday.

makeovers.beforeSentence: Oops! We stepped onto the ___ train platform.
makeovers.earVerdict: Doesn't fit — picking the mistaken route always takes 'wrong'.
makeovers.spokenSentence: Oops! We stepped onto the wrong train platform.

cousinWords.miniContext: The alarm triggered after a mistaken reading from the sensor.
That online rumor proved completely untrue yesterday.
Fake marks the strongest tone in error -> untruth.

quests.coreMeaning: Holding as much as possible inside.
quests.whyDifferent: 'Full' describes containers (`full cup`) or schedules. 'Crowded' specifically means packed with too many people.

makeovers.beforeSentence: Morning trains get very ___ near the central hub.
makeovers.earVerdict: Natural — spaces packed with people are 'crowded'.
makeovers.spokenSentence: Morning trains get very crowded near the central hub.

makeovers.beforeSentence: Hold the ___ mug carefully so it stays level.
makeovers.earVerdict: Doesn't fit — liquids inside cups take 'full', never 'crowded'.
makeovers.spokenSentence: Hold the full mug carefully so it stays level.

cousinWords.miniContext: Shoppers avoided the packed mall on holiday weekends.

Stuffed marks the strongest tone in busy -> overwhelmed.

makeovers.earVerdict: Natural — freeing someone from danger uses 'rescue'.
makeovers.spokenSentence: Hikers called volunteers to rescue the trapped goat.

quests.coreMeaning: To separate or damage a surface.

makeovers.spokenSentence: Designers create colorful logos for local festivals.
